Learning Management System untuk institu: Learning Management System for government institutions: civil servant training management, structured learning modules, and computer-based exams.
Berfungsi sebagai pusat pelatihan dan se: It serves as the training and certification hub — from registration, learning materials, computer-based test (CBT) scheduling, to result recaps and certificate issuance.
Pengelolaan pelatihan ASN & penjadwalan: Civil servant training management & class scheduling
Rekapitulasi nilai, laporan instansi, da: Score recaps, agency reports, and certificates
Institusi membutuhkan satu tempat untuk: The institution needed one place to manage employee training from registration to final evaluation — without overlapping data scattered across many files.
Modul pembelajaran dan pelaksanaan ujian: Learning modules and computer-based exam delivery are designed in one ecosystem so training results go straight into participant recaps.
Nilai ujian terhitung otomatis, terdokum: Exam scores are computed automatically, documented per participant, and can be reported to the agency without manual recap work.
